criteria.text: Gross yearly revenue of $10 million or less
criteria.quote: Small businesses or start-ups operating in Canada, with gross annual revenues of $10 million or less.
Not eligible under this program: farming businesses

criteria.text: A bank, caisse populaire or credit union approves the loan
criteria.quote: Financial institutions deliver the program and are solely responsible for approving the loan.

research.notes: Type loan: the program shares risk on loans from financial institutions, which deliver it and approve the loan. Intake: no page says when to apply (you apply to a lender), so unknown rather than a guessed "any time". Structure: the FAQ says eligible "for-profit, not-for-profit and charitable small businesses" "can be corporations, sole proprietors, partnerships or cooperatives", and "start-ups" are eligible too, so no structure answer is ruled out and there is no structure rule ("Not registered yet" would be unclear, which core does not support yet). Farming: "farming businesses" is narrower than NAICS sector 11 (which also covers forestry, fishing and hunting), so it is a check-yourself item, not an industry rule. Maximum: $1.15 million per borrower; the $500,000 and $150,000 sub-limits for equipment, leaseholds, intangibles and working capital are in the amount text or left here. No program phone: lenders are the contact.
